concerns.text: FR-001 requires downloading 'FlavorDB chemical matrix' and 'Counterfactual Recipe Generation dataset'. The tasks.md (T001b, T013, T051) exclusively implements Recipe1M downloads. No task exists to fetch or process FlavorDB or Counterfactual datasets, leaving the original spec requirement unimplemented.

FR-004 mandates calculating cosine similarity using 'chemical vectors' from FlavorDB. Tasks T014c and T016 implement similarity using 'Recipe1M visual/text embeddings'. No task covers the retrieval or processing of FlavorDB chemical vectors as required by the spec.

FR-001b requires verifying the 'Counterfactual Recipe Generation dataset' for independent sensory labels. Tasks T012 and T046 verify Recipe1M and Ratings URLs. No task exists to verify the Counterfactual dataset schema or availability.

SC-001 defines success as measuring 'independent explanatory power' via a likelihood-ratio test. Tasks T024b and T024c implement 'Partial Correlation' and document the switch. No task implements the Likelihood-Ratio Test required by the current spec text.
US-1 Scenario 2 specifies normalization using 'mapping to the FlavorDB canonical list'. Task T014 normalizes against the 'Recipe1M ingredient list'. No task implements the FlavorDB mapping logic.

Task T012c references 'Spec amendment for FR-001' but the spec.md provided in the input still contains the original FR-001 (FlavorDB/Counterfactual). The task assumes an amended spec that is not present in the current artifact set, creating a stale tag/reference mismatch.

Task T024c references 'amendment of FR-008' (Likelihood-Ratio to Partial Correlation). The spec.md provided still lists FR-008 as requiring a Likelihood-Ratio Test. The task tag references a spec state not reflected in the input artifact.
